From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Sep 2026 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Notes from Nila reference calls (Priyanka + Tom) — summary + highlights

Hey team — quick consolidated notes from both reference calls (attached full notes file): call-notes-Nila-20260917.txt (also saved at https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExampleDriveLink)

Summary (30–60s read):
- Overall recommendation: PRIYANKA: Strongly recommended; TOM: Recommended with minor caveat.
- Strengths called out: ownership on migrations, pragmatic debugging under pressure, cross-functional communication (PMs + Data Scientists).
- Concern: Tom flagged limited exposure to multi-region infra and some drive to implement infra-wide observability (not a showstopper for this role).

Detailed bullets:
- Priyanka (FinLytics) — 25 min
  - Confirmed Nila led k8s ETL migration; authored runbooks; on-call rotation leader for incident mitigation.
  - Examples: reduced mean time to recovery for ETL failures by ~40% via incremental rollout + enhanced error handling.
  - Personality: calm under pressure, good at writing concise postmortems.

- Tom (EdgeAI) — 22 min
  - Managed a team that worked with Nila on integrating GPU-backed model inference.
  - Strengths: solid debugging, mentor to junior engineers.
  - Caveat: less hands-on with multi-region failover patterns; would want to pair with a senior infra engineer for initial ramp.

Recommendation: Move Nila to final onsite/loop. Suggest a short technical pairing session on multi-region failover in the first week of onboarding if hired.

Attachments: call-notes-Nila-20260917.txt

Thanks — I updated the candidate record in HubSpot: HUBSPOT-CR-9032 and attached the notes. If you want me to include any redacted quote snippets in the candidate packet, say so and I’ll add them.

—Marissa
Recruiter, Redwood Inference
